notes.title: New textures, collecting presents, and introducing Sprinkles, the trash can elf!
notes.content:
Santa's workshop has received a makeover, and now has a cozy feel with its wooden textures
 Binkles the elf is no longer a giant, and is scaled appropriately down in size
 Sprinkles the trash can elf has been added, and can now teleport you to different parts of the map via the inner connected trashcan system
 Presents are no longer infinite, you have a certain amount of "ammo", and must collect more to be able to shoot/deliver them
You can now collect presents one at a time while running around on the ground via Christmas stockings
 You can quickly collect presents while on the ground, or on the sled by going near a Present Pickup station

notes.title: Candy cane booster fix
notes.content: Fixed bug where candy cane boosters wouldn't show after being unlocked

notes.title: Greetings from Dev
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I am the dev for Christmas Cats. I'm excited to be working on Christmas Cats, and I want to share a few ideas of some of my goals are for Christmas Cats.

[olist]
 Final release date Christmas 2023
 10 unlockable levels
 Hidden cookies to find in each level which help unlock other upgrades/levels
 Overworld
 Voice acted and cinematic shots at start/end of each level
 rat enemy NPC characters
 powerup presents
 Ramps meant for cats
[/olist]

What is currently in Christmas Cats

 You play as one of the 4 main Christmas Cats who can either: run on all fours, or ride a sled
 One level (other than the overworld)
 Collectable powerups that fill your magic gauge
 4 player split screen
 Presents that launch from the front of your sled
 Ramps that lead into houses (meant for presents only, no kitties allowed)
 Presents get boosted by ramp
 King rat (villain) is ready to act
 Santa (gets ratnapped) is ready to go



I have other updates I have posted on the Kickstarter for Christmas Cats as well. I will try to post updates here, from now on!

Check out the Kickstarter here


-Steven DiLeo
